messages.en:
{07 04 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} I told you I
was coming...{07 15 00} AND YOU STOOD
ME UP!!{01 00 00 0a 00} HOW RUDE!!
{07 06 00}Y'know, I was waiting in
front of your house for a
looooooooong time!
{07 15 00}I hope you go to JAIL!{01 00 00 0a 00} And
that your stupid house is
TORN DOWN, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma ütlesin, et
tulen...{07 15 00} JA SA JÄTSID
MU OOTAMA!!{01 00 00 0a 00} KUI EBAVIISAKAS!!
{07 06 00}Tead, ma ootasin
sinu maja ees
väga-väga kaua!
{07 15 00}Loodan, et sa lähed VANGI!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Ja et su rumal maja
LAMMUTATAKSE, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} didn't I tell you
that I was coming over?{01 00 00 0a 00}
I swear I did...
{07 15 00}AHA!!{01 00 00 0a 00} I KNEW IT!{01 00 00 05 00} You just
remembered, DIDN'T YOU,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
{07 16 00}I can't BELIEVE you forgot
until right now! That...that
makes me sooo sad!{07 00 00}{07 08 00} WAAAAH!{03 03 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Kuule,{01 00 00 05 00} kas ma ei öelnud
sulle, et ma tulen külla?{01 00 00 0a 00}
Ma vannun, et ütlesin...
{07 15 00}AHAA!!{01 00 00 0a 00} MA TEADSIN!{01 00 00 05 00} Sa alles
nüüd meenutasid, KAS POLE,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
{07 16 00}Ma ei USU, et sa unustasid
kuni praeguseni! See...see
teeb mind nii kurvaks!{07 00 00}{07 08 00} AAAH!{03 03 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Ahhh!!{01 00 00 05 00} Now I remember!{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}I was going to visit you,
and you stood me up!
{07 15 00}What happened?{01 00 00 05 00} Did you go
on a DATE or something,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}In that case, you should
have brought me along so
we could double-date!
{07 16 00}But I don't have anyone to
ask, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}...{01 00 00 0f 00} Except
stupid old {04 0c 00}...{03 03 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ahhh!!{01 00 00 05 00} Nüüd mäletan!{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}Ma pidin sind külastama
ja sa jätsid mu ootama!
{07 15 00}Mis juhtus?{01 00 00 05 00} Kas sa läksid
KOHTINGULE või nii,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}Sel juhul oleksid sa pidanud
mu kaasa võtma, et me
saaksime koos kohtingule!
{07 16 00}Aga mul pole kedagi, keda
kutsuda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}...{01 00 00 0f 00} Peale
rumal vana {04 0c 00}...{03 03 00 01}
